request.query: For an arbitrary real x the natural floor of the real square root x equals the natural square root of the natural floor of x

items.name: Tactic.NormNum.isNat_sqrt
items.type: ∀ {x nx z : ℕ}, Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat x nx → nx.sqrt = z → Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat x.sqrt z

items.name: Tactic.NormNum.isNat_realSqrt
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ} {nx ny : ℕ}, Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat x nx → ny * ny = nx → Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat (√x) ny

items.name: Tactic.NormNum.isNat_nnrealSqrt
items.type:
∀ {x : NNReal} {nx ny : ℕ},
  Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat x nx → ny * ny = nx → Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat (NNReal.sqrt x) ny
